definition: acting on what fires rather than on what I resolve to do

settled:
Everything I do is fired by something. Nothing is begun by deciding to.

Right and true are one word to me, so once a thing sits in my map as right the act runs. No gap to cross. A cold verdict that a thing is right produces the act with no warmth riding on it.

What matters is loud, and whatever is bottlenecking me is the loudest thing in the field.

Cheap change is on the way in: I rewrite what reaches me rather than how I answer it.

Expensive change is pain grinding the response down over many repetitions. A response misfires, the miss itself is the pain, and the pain is what retrains the response.

Nothing teaches me like pain. It is also the one signal of mine that never runs quiet, so the same channel is both my clearest read and my only real teacher.

The nearest I come to being deliberate is when what a trigger fires is a piece of work to change my triggers. That still started with a trigger. It is triggers the whole way down.

title: Nothing I Do Starts With A Decision
